## Contract review (`claude-fable-5-1`, isolated seat) — PR #8636 @ `4983cb9`

**Verdict: CHANGES REQUIRED** — one line of changeset prose. The type face, the pin, the bump grade, the census and the carriers all check out; what does not is a factual sentence in a file that becomes release notes.

Reviewed head `4983cb98971292c82d3d3f864544b84f4feba747` (1 commit, linear on merge-base `c4326fe`; `origin/main` at read time `00ce6bf`). Read-only: `refs/review/8636` fetched, `git show`/`git diff`/`git grep` only, ref deleted afterwards; nothing checked out, nothing run against the tree. Where a leg needs execution (`tsc`), I read the mechanism and cite CI on this head rather than a local run.

**Ruling implemented:** decision batch #101, card #8583 comment `5588930745` — the **director seat** applying two **maintainer** rulings (batch #87, objectui#8367 `5582071618` confirmed `5582246697` 「批 #87 同意」; and the 2026-08-27 retirement-pacing ruling 「项目在创业阶段，用户也很少，短期不考虑渐进。」), not a new ruling of its own. Quoted once, the execution paragraph:

> Delete `collapsed?: boolean` and its docblock from the `sections[]` entry; `defaultCollapsed` (landed by item 1, PR #8601) is the spelling. […] remove the member and docblock; a type-level pin (reached by the leg that type-checks, not vitest alone — the card's own lesson) that a `sections[]` literal with `collapsed` is refused by `tsc` and one with `defaultCollapsed` is accepted; changeset `@object-ui/types` `minor` with a **BREAKING** banner and the FROM/TO (`collapsed` → `defaultCollapsed`), no migration prescription; `Clause-②: yes` […]; no other member touched, `hideEmpty` stays out.

Implemented: yes, with two documented deviations from the ruling's letter that I re-measured and confirm are correct (findings 2 and 3 below) — the ruling's census had two wrong lines, and the PR followed the ruling's intent ("no other member touched") over its letter in both cases.

**Governed paths touched: NO** — diff vs merge-base is exactly four files: `.changeset/retire-record-details-section-collapsed.md` (+31), `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts` (1/1), `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-details-section-members-8583.test.ts` (+82/−5), `packages/types/src/record-components.ts` (−1). Nothing under `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `content/docs/releases/**`; CI `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success.

**Clause-②: yes (`feat!`)** — accept set narrows on a published type face. Carriers present: `needs:contract-review` on the PR (labels: `package: types`, `tests`, `needs:contract-review`) and on card #8583. PR body opens `Fixes #8583` (one PR, `Fixes`, as the ruling asked). RULE 2: the single commit carries no card-relation trailer — subject references `(objectui#8583)`, body has no `Fixes`/`Closes`, trailers are `Co-Authored-By` and `Claude-Session` only.

### The hunk
`record-components.ts` @@ −117,7 +117,6: the only change is `-    collapsed?: boolean;` between `collapsible?: boolean;` and `}>;`. Section entry on the head declares exactly `name, label, fields, group, columns, icon, description, showBorder, defaultCollapsed, headerColor, collapsible` — the six from PR #8601 (`columns, icon, description, showBorder, defaultCollapsed, headerColor`) all present with their docblocks; `hideEmpty` absent (`git grep -w hideEmpty` on the file: no hit). `complex.ts:146`, `navigation.ts:154`, `objectql.ts:1073`, `packages/types/src/zod/**`, `packages/types/package.json`: zero diff vs merge-base.

### The pin (type-checked, not vitest-only)
`packages/types/tsconfig.test.json` `include: ["src/**/*.test.ts", "src/**/*.test.tsx"]` — both test files are program inputs of the third leg of `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`); the build project `tsconfig.json` excludes `**/__tests__/**`, so this leg is the only one that reads the pin. CI `Type Check` on `4983cb9`: success (19:02:03Z).
Mechanism, read off the head file: `type Expect<T extends true> = T` and `type IsSectionMember<K> = K extends keyof Section ? true : false`. `// @ts-expect-error` sits on `type _CollapsedIsRetired = Expect<IsSectionMember<'collapsed'>>` (TS2344 today) and on the `collapsed: true` key of a `RecordDetailsComponentProps` section literal (TS2353 today); `type _DefaultCollapsedSurvives = Expect<IsSectionMember<'defaultCollapsed'>>` and a `defaultCollapsed: true` literal carry **no** directive and must compile. Re-adding the member turns both directives unused → **TS2578**, so the file reddens rather than silently passing — yes, the unused-`@ts-expect-error` mechanism is what makes it a pin. Instrument controls are present (`_ExpectRefusesFalse`, `_EqualRefusesNever/Any`, `_UndeclaredKeyIsRefused`). Runtime half: two-control read on the installed spec (`defaultCollapsed` in the section key list, `collapsed` not; canonical section + `collapsed` → `unrecognized_keys` naming exactly `['collapsed']`).

### Census (re-run on the head)
`git grep -n -w collapsed refs/review/8636 -- 'packages/plugin-detail/src/**' 'packages/types/src/record-components.ts' 'examples/**' 'content/docs/**'`: 41 hits, every one classified — prose/comments, `RecordChatterPanel`/`RelatedList` local state, `buildDefaultPageSchema` `collapse: 'collapsed'` (a different key, mapped *to* `defaultCollapsed` at `:722`), `mockDataSource.ts:46` (a `fieldGroups` comment), `schema-reference.md:826` (the `ObjectFormSection` legacy alias), breadcrumb `collapsed-trail`, kanban lane. **Zero readers or writers of `RecordDetailsComponentProps.sections[].collapsed`**; `packages/plugin-detail` reads `defaultCollapsed` only (`DetailSection.tsx:142` control hit). Writers-in-TS: `\bcollapsed\s*:` over `packages/types/src/**`, `packages/plugin-detail/src/**`, `packages/react/src/**`, `apps/**` — all remaining hits are `ObjectFormSection`, `RenderableSection` (console `FormPage.tsx:449/556`), kanban/navigation zod, or the pin's own directive-guarded literals. `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`: no `RecordDetails`/`record-components` reference (the type has no zod mirror), untouched — no drift row can move.

### Changeset
`@object-ui/types: minor` ✔ · `**BREAKING** — …` banner ✔ · `**FROM** collapsed **TO** defaultCollapsed` + before/after snippet ✔ · no migration prescription ✔ (only "rename the key at the authoring site", i.e. the FROM/TO restated) · census limit carried ✔. Convention: AGENTS.md:240 — objectui's own breaking changes are `minor` with the break spelled out in the body; `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` enforces it; siblings (`3917-retire-action-condition-branch.md`, `13626-formview-section-style-keys-retired.md`) follow the same shape. ADR-0087 has no objectui counterpart (`docs/adr/` has no 0087) and does not apply — this retires a TS type-face member, not a `packages/spec` property. Gates on the head: `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report` all success. **One false sentence — finding 1.**

### CI reading (head `4983cb9`, read once)
33 check runs, all completed: 30 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, the `Test (coverage shard …)` matrix template, `dependabot`). Named: `Type Check` ✔ · `Build Docs` ✔ · `Test (shard 1/4)` ✔ · `Test (shard 2/4)` ✔ · `Test (shard 3/4)` ✔ · `Test (shard 4/4)` ✔ · `Lint` ✔ · `Build & E2E` ✔ · `Doc Snippet Type Check` ✔ · `Doc Component Type Check` ✔ · `Governed Surface Queue Guard` ✔. `mergeable_state`: `unknown` at read time (not computed by GitHub yet). **Draft: yes.**

### Findings

1. **Medium — false fact in published release-notes input.** The changeset ends: "Retires the last member of the divergence objectui#8583 measured; the six keys this type used to omit landed in the previous release." Item 1's changeset `.changeset/8583-record-details-section-members.md` is **still pending on this PR's own base `c4326fe`** (and on the head), and `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md`'s top entry `## 17.6.0` has zero `8583` mentions — both items ship in the **same** release. A changeset is this repo's input to `content/docs/releases/`, so the sentence would be wrong where people outside this thread read it. *Expectation:* reword (e.g. "…the six keys this type used to omit land in the same release, item 1") or drop the clause; nothing else in the file moves; the corrective push moves the head, so the re-review of the increment should confirm the diff vs `4983cb9` touches only that file.
2. **Low / accepted — scope beyond "one member removal + pin + changeset".** `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts:501` renamed `collapsed: true` → `defaultCollapsed: true` on a `RecordDetailsComponentProps` fixture. Re-measured: that line exists identically at the ruling's census SHA `9f5de79d` and at `c4326fe`, so the ruling's "zero `collapsed:` in any record-details test" was false, and since `tsconfig.test.json` compiles that file the deletion alone would have reddened `Type Check`. Fixture triage of the retired spelling, not a fixture the pin replaced; the ruling's `defaultCollapsed`-is-the-spelling clause covers it. *Expectation:* none — correct as done; recorded because the brief counts anything beyond the three items.
3. **Info — the ruling's ":100 docblock" does not exist for this member.** At `9f5de79d` and `c4326fe` alike, `:100` is the second line of the `/** … */` block at `:99–104` whose member is `:105 defaultCollapsed?: boolean;`, and `:119 collapsible?: boolean;` sits directly above `:120 collapsed?: boolean;`. `collapsed` never had a docblock; deleting `:100` would have been the "other member touched" the ruling forbids. The PR's one-line deletion is the correct reading. *Expectation:* none; the director seat may want to note the correction on the card for the record.
4. **Low — PR-body measurement not reproducible as written (body only, not published).** `git grep -nE '\.collapsed\b' … packages/*/src …` "exit 1, zero lines": under git pathspec rules `'packages/*/src'` matches **0** files (`packages/*/src/**` matches 3954), so neither the zero nor the `\.defaultCollapsed\b` control could have fired in that form; with the glob, `\.collapsed\b` hits **14** files — all other types (kanban lane, grouping fields, `ObjectFormSection`/`DrawerForm`, navigation, `useCollapsibleChatsList`, `RenderableSection`). The **conclusion** (zero readers of this member) holds on my per-hit classification; the stated command/result pair does not. *Expectation:* correct the body's command or its stated result so the evidence can be re-run.
5. **Nit — changeset filename.** `.changeset/README.md:51` prescribes `<issue>-<slug>.md`; this one is `retire-record-details-section-collapsed.md` while its sibling item-1 file is `8583-…`. No gate enforces it (`Changeset Overwrite Report` success, no collision). *Expectation:* optional rename to `8583-retire-record-details-section-collapsed.md` if the head moves anyway for finding 1; not blocking.

**Maintainer-only merge: no** — a `feat!` type-face narrowing under a director-seat ruling that applies two confirmed maintainer rulings, non-governed paths, changeset grade per AGENTS.md:240; the required change (finding 1) is one line of prose the dev seat fixes and the director seat lands after a targeted re-review of the increment. Nothing here needs the maintainer.
